description: Implement cohort/group management with QR-code generation and the staff admin dashboard. When a new survey group (cohort) is created, generate a QR code that encodes the URL to the vocational-test form scoped to that cohort (e.g. https://<host>/g/{CODE} or /assessment?cohort={CODE}) and surface it in the create-cohort flow and admin area so staff can share/print it. Also port the admin dashboard: list evaluations/sessions with cohort filtering, reviewer dictamen (notes + review status), and cohort listing. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema/seed/db) and FEAT-002 (assessment routes the QR points to).
steps: Add a QR-code capability: install a QR library (e.g. `qrcode` for server-side data-URL/SVG generation, or `qrcode.react` for client rendering). Create web/lib/qr.ts (or a component) that, given a cohort code and the app base URL, builds the scoped test URL (prefer /g/{CODE}, which FEAT-002 maps to the cohort-scoped assessment) and produces a QR image (SVG or PNG data URL).

Build the cohort create flow web/app/admin/cohorts (list + create) equivalent to CohortSelectorDialog.kt/CreateCohortDialog.kt: form with fields code (uppercased, e.g. BIO-2026-C), title, institution, description. On create, insert into cohort_groups via a server action/route (web/app/api/cohorts/route.ts) with created_at, is_active=true, creator_name from the current staff user.

Immediately after a cohort is created (and on demand from the cohort list), render/display its QR code linking to the scoped test URL, with the human-readable URL shown beneath and a download/print action. Ensure the encoded URL uses a configurable base URL (env NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL or request origin) so it works on the deployed Vercel domain.

Build the admin dashboard web/app/admin/page.tsx porting AdminDashboardScreen.kt behavior: tabs/sections for evaluations & audit (list assessment_sessions with search by student/email/dominant code and filter by cohort, summary counts of total/valid/pending), cohort management (list cohorts + their QR + create), and users directory. Load data from Neon (lazy). Keep role-based section labels in Spanish per UserRole.

Implement reviewer dictamen: a route/action web/app/api/sessions/[id]/review/route.ts to update reviewer_notes and review_status (PENDING/IN_REVIEW/APPROVED/NEEDS_FOLLOWUP from ReviewStatus) on a session, surfaced via a review dialog/form in the dashboard (equivalent to ReviewerFeedbackDialog).

Provide a lightweight role/user selector (the Android app has no real auth; it seeds users and lets you switch role). Port an equivalent: allow selecting the acting user/role from seeded users so staff sections are reachable. Do not implement real OAuth (out of scope); document this in the README.
Ensure build/typecheck pass without a live DB.
acceptance_criteria: Creating a cohort inserts a cohort_groups row and then displays a QR code encoding the scoped test URL (/g/{CODE} or /assessment?cohort={CODE}).
Scanning/opening the encoded URL lands on the assessment scoped to that cohort code (integrates with FEAT-002).
The QR-encoded URL uses a configurable base URL (env or request origin), not a hard-coded localhost.
Admin dashboard lists sessions with cohort filter + search and shows total/valid/pending counts.
Reviewer can save notes + a review status onto a session.
`cd web && npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` pass.
findings: Completed cohort QR + full admin dashboard + reviewer dictamen. NEW: web/lib/qr.ts (pure helpers normalizeCohortCode/resolveBaseUrl/buildCohortTestUrl) builds the scoped test URL preferring /g/{CODE} with a CONFIGURABLE base URL (env NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL when set, else request origin/window.location.origin, else relative path) so QR links work on the deployed Vercel domain, never hard-coded localhost. web/app/api/sessions/[id]/review/route.ts (PATCH, force-dynamic, runtime=nodejs) validates reviewStatus against REVIEW_STATUS keys and updates reviewer_notes + review_status. web/tests/qr.test.ts (8 tests). EXTENDED: web/lib/actions/cohorts.ts +listCohorts() merges Neon cohort_groups (DB priority) with DEFAULT_COHORTS seed, guarded try/catch so it returns seed-only without DATABASE_URL. web/lib/sessions.ts +listSessions()/SessionSummary (guarded, returns [] on no-DB) and +updateSessionReview(). web/components/QrCode.tsx now offers Descargar (PNG data-url download) + Imprimir (print window) actions. web/components/AdminClient.tsx rewritten into a tabbed dashboard porting AdminDashboardScreen.kt: (a) Evaluaciones & Auditoria — search by student/email/dominant code + cohort filter + summary counts total/valid(is_valid)/pending(review_status==='PENDING' or empty notes), session cards with review dialog (ReviewerFeedbackDialog equivalent) that PATCHes the review route and Ver diagnostico -> /results/{id}; (b) Gestion de Cohortes — create form (code uppercased, creator_name from acting user, only for SUPER_ADMIN/TEST_ADMIN) + cohort list each with QR (linkFor uses buildCohortTestUrl), human-readable URL, download/print, and 'Abrir formulario del grupo' -> /g/{CODE}; (c) Directorio de Usuarios — DEFAULT_USERS. Lightweight role/user selector picks the acting user from DEFAULT_USERS (no real OAuth; noted inline in UI + web/.env.example). web/app/admin/page.tsx is now a server component (force-dynamic, runtime=nodejs) that awaits listCohorts()+listSessions() at runtime only. Added NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL to web/.env.example. NOTE/DEVIATION: step 6 says 'document OAuth out of scope in the README' but no README exists yet (FEAT-005 scope) — documented inline in the admin UI and .env.example instead; FEAT-005 should add the note to the README it creates. VERIFICATION (all from web/, DATABASE_URL unset): npm run typecheck OK, npm run test -- --run 39 tests pass (3 files), npm run lint clean, npm run build succeeds — /admin and /api/sessions/[id]/review render as dynamic (ƒ) so no DB access at build time.
